Hi Jamie / Ravi — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Objectives: Confirm scope for the security review to support your procurement timeline (target decision: mid-September).
- Systems discussed: API integrations for patient-facing summaries (prod), internal analytics (staging), and SFTP drop for batch imports (prod).
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: clear data residency controls, SOC 2 evidence, and latency SLAs for inference endpoints.

Action items / asks:
1) Please confirm who the economic buyer is and the procurement timeline.
2) Can you confirm the security/legal/procurement contacts we should loop in?
3) We’ll send the intake questionnaire and a proposed scope matrix to start — aim to get the intake back within 5 business days if possible.

I’ve cc’d Neha (security) and Sean (account lead) to help coordinate questionnaire intake and to map stakeholders.

Proposed next step: 30-min kickoff with your security and procurement folks next week so we can walk the questionnaire and clarify system boundaries. When works best?

Thanks,

Hi all — Neha from the security team here. Thanks for the intros, Jamie. A couple of things to help scope the questionnaire intake: 

1) Systems in scope (please confirm):
   - Production inference endpoints serving patient-facing summaries (hosted, production)
   - Internal analytics cluster (staging) that accesses de-identified vectors
   - SFTP batch import for claims data (prod)

2) Data classification: are any of these systems expected to process PHI that would require HIPAA BA considerations? If yes, flag which ones.

3) Evidence we typically need up front: SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, data retention policy, and network diagram. If you have an internal security questionnaire (Excel/PDF), please share so we can avoid duplicate asks.

For procurement/legal: a short procurement checklist is helpful — expected contract term, any required SLAs, and whether you need a DPAs. Happy to join the kickoff to walk through the questionnaire and clarify items.

If Tue 8/17 10:00am PT works, I’ll reserve time and send a calendar invite with a proposed agenda (intake review, systems scope, evidence list, next steps).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

- 5-15m: Questionnaire intake — clarify system boundaries and which sections you own (Neha)

- 25-30m: Next steps and timeline for completion (Marissa)

Attachments: Orchard_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (intake we use to map requirements) and Orchard_Network_Diagram.pdf (example of what we request). Please review the questionnaire and flag any items that should be routed to legal/procurement.

Pre-kickoff asks: 
- Ravi / Jamie: confirm whether the production inference endpoints will handle PHI (HIPAA scope). If yes, note which connectors/processes are in scope.
- Anita: if you have an internal security questionnaire, please share so we can align fields and avoid duplication.
